brand.name: Mutual
brand.intro_title: Golf as a lifestyle people want in on.
brand.intro: Mutual is a modern golf media platform founded in 2025. We dive into the culture, stories and lifestyle behind the game — turning golf from a sport people watch into a lifestyle people want to be part of.
brand.group: Part of Redwoods Digital Growth Group

hero.line: Tournaments, shows and community nights — the stories, people and places that make golf a lifestyle.

pillars.title: YouTube shows
pillars.text: Long-form series that show the many sides of golf — for golfers and everyone outside the circle.

pillars.title: Vertical series
pillars.text: Quick, sharp golf in under a minute, for Instagram and TikTok.

pillars.title: Feed & editorial
pillars.text: Stories on traditions, places, gear and the people of the game.

pillars.title: Real-life experiences
pillars.text: Tournaments, a reality show, markets, clinics and community nights.

youtube.name: ASMR
youtube.short: The pure sound of the game
youtube.text: A sensory-driven series that shows the beauty of golf through pure, immersive sound — club strikes and natural course ambience, with pro athletes and public figures.

youtube.name: Fairway Talk
youtube.text: Relaxed conversations on the course with athletes, public figures and golfers — between shots, with nothing scripted.

youtube.name: State of Par
youtube.text: A casual video podcast where conversations flow, perspectives collide and the game never stops — guests from sports, culture and creative scenes.

youtube.name: Can We Even Swing?
youtube.text: We invite non-golfers to try golf and see what happens. First swings, first reactions, first impressions — and a verdict at the end: Yes or No to Golf?

youtube.name: Play Off
youtube.text: A crossover golf challenge where competition meets entertainment: four players in a spirited match, building hype for upcoming tournaments.

youtube.name: Coach Says
youtube.text: Breaks down the most common golf problems and delivers practical, easy-to-apply solutions directly from real coaches.

youtube.name: Golf Tour
youtube.text: Explores golf spaces — courses, driving ranges, golf cafés and communities — and the places, people and culture that shape modern golf. Hosted by Jonathan Rian and Edward Halim.

youtube.name: Off Course
youtube.text: Stories, perspectives and cultural influences around the game, spotlighting the people and ideas shaping golf outside the course.

vertical.name: Golf 60
vertical.text: A short-form series packed with golf knowledge, fun facts and surprising stories — delivered in under a minute, one clip at a time.

vertical.name: Off Course
vertical.text: Goes beyond the scorecard to uncover the real stories behind every swing — why golfers started, what keeps them hooked and what makes golf unlike any other sport.

vertical.name: Hot Takes
vertical.text: Golfers on the spot with quick this-or-that choices — favourite courses, gear, routines, playlists and traditions.

vertical.name: One Hole With
vertical.text: A community-driven Reel series where golfers share one hole, one moment and one story from their round.

vertical.name: re:store
vertical.text: Revisits new releases with second thoughts and fresh perspectives — how golf equipment, fashion and accessories change in meaning over time.

editorial.name: Social Round
editorial.text: Where golf connects people, sparks friendships and builds community — the stories and faces that make the sport inclusive.

editorial.name: Unwritten
editorial.text: Traditions, legends, unspoken rules and the lore of the game.

editorial.name: Groundwave
editorial.text: Serene and picturesque golf destinations — scenic golfscapes mixed with food and lifestyle.

editorial.name: re:store
editorial.text: Revisits releases with fresh perspectives — how golf equipment, fashion and accessories change in meaning over time.

events.name: Charity Classic Golf Tournament
events.place: Organised for Marriott Worldwide Business Councils Indonesia
events.text: An annual charity golf tournament raising funds for a clean-water project in Sumba. Mutual was the organising partner: tournament planning, event organising, promotion and marketing, and hosting the auction.

events.name: Mutual Major Vol. 2
events.text: Mutual’s flagship open tournament, bringing together top players, influential voices and brand partners from many industries.

events.name: Mutual Major · Reality Show
events.text: An unorthodox, festival-style golf tournament that blends competitive sport with lifestyle entertainment and community culture — filmed as a reality show.

events.name: Mutual Major Vol. 1
events.text: A 6-hole tournament full of twists and fun challenges, with curated players in teams. Golf here isn’t just technique — it’s team strategy and play.

events.name: Mutual Grounds Market
events.text: A pop-up market and community space that combines shopping with interactive golf: a virtual tournament by Swing50n, demo clubs and Beat the Pro by TaylorMade.

events.name: Coach Says Live
events.place: The Range at Damai Indah Golf PIK
events.text: An intimate offline edition of our YouTube series: hands-on coaching on the range, club demos, one-on-one sessions and a friendly place to learn golf. A second, invitation-only edition was held with Kiara Society.

events.name: Mutual Club & Card launch
events.text: A pre-event for Mutual Major Vol. 2 — a party for the golf community with mingling, fun games and the soft launch of the Mutual Club × Club of Five line.

cases.name: Jakarta International Championship
cases.text: A multi-programme campaign before the championship — Play Off, Fairway Talk and Off Course — with Indonesia’s top players, public figures and the venue.

cases.name: Indonesia Development Open
cases.text: A full-cycle documentary following the people behind the event, from rookies to pros — competition, conversations and highlights.

cases.name: APPI footballers × Play Off
cases.text: Maingolfyuk versus APPI footballers in Play Off and Fairway Talk — a crossover that brought football fans to golf.

products.name: Mutual Club × Club of Five
products.text: A merchandise collaboration bringing together golf, local brands and lifestyle culture — sport-inspired design with contemporary style.

products.name: The Mutual Card
products.text: A community-driven membership that connects golfers, courses and brands with one purpose: growing the game together. Powered by The Card, owned by APLGI. Three tiers: Infinite, Silver and Millennial.

products.name: Orangegrounds × The Mutual Golf
products.text: A merchandise collaboration with Orangegrounds Golf & Coffee — golf culture meets coffee lifestyle in an everyday apparel piece.

products.name: Akross × Mutual
products.text: Golf meets outdoor utility: Mutual’s modern golf lifestyle with Akross’ functional approach to outdoor apparel, made for movement from the course to the city.

products.name: Mutual Club activations
products.text: Retail pop-ups and club days that bring the Mutual lifestyle onto the course and into the city.

work.title: Brand partnership
work.text: Put your brand inside our shows, verticals and events — from product placement to a full programme built around you.

work.title: Events & activations
work.text: Tournaments, clinics, markets and community nights, planned, produced and filmed by Mutual.

about.group_title: Part of Redwoods Digital Growth Group
about.group_text: Redwoods Digital Growth Group is a creative holding group that builds and invests in IP and ventures across media, programmes & events, place-making and IP characters. Mutual was brought to life by merging several of its portfolios — consulting, media and community.
